Strata plan NWS2534. items.t: Moody Park is a City of New Westminster neighbourhood centred on Moody Park itself, in the Uptown-west area between 6th Avenue and 8th Avenue, bounded in the City's heritage context material by 8th Avenue, 8th Street, 10th Street and 6th Avenue. Uptown is to the east, Brow of the Hill to the west, Glenbrooke North to the north, and Downtown and the Quay down the hill to the south.

The apartment stock sits on the edges: Eighth Street and Eighth Avenue around the park (The Diplomat, Moody Gardens, The Doncaster, Villa Franciscan) and Eighth Avenue east toward 12th Street (Fraser Gardens). There are no towers in the sub-area; the verified stock is low-rise.

Landmarks and services on the edges: Moody Park itself (outdoor pool, spray park, sports fields), Moody Park Arena at 701 Eighth Avenue, the New Westminster Public Library Main Branch at 716 Sixth Avenue, and the təməsew̓txʷ Aquatic and Community Centre at 65 East Sixth Avenue, fully opened May 2024.

Transit: no SkyTrain station is inside Moody Park; the nearest are New Westminster Station and Columbia Station (Expo Line) downtown. TransLink routes 105 (Uptown / New Westminster Station) and 106 (Edmonds Station / New Westminster Station) serve the adjoining Uptown corridors.

blocks.text: Good to know about Moody Park

items.t: The condo stock hides on the park's edges, not in the middle. The residential streets between 6th and 10th are RS-zoned houses (RS-1: 557.40 m² minimum site, FSR 0.5); every verified apartment building sits on Eighth Street, Eighth Avenue or the avenues' edges under the multiple-unit RM districts. A "Moody Park condo" search that returns interior-street product is returning something else.
Two of the five buildings are the same age as each other and share a manager pattern worth checking.

The city's newest recreation asset is at the area's east edge. The təməsew̓txʷ Aquatic and Community Centre at 65 East Sixth Avenue fully opened in May 2024 — at 10,644 sq. m. the City's largest capital project to date, with an eight-lane 50-metre pool, leisure pool, fitness centre and gymnasia — a short walk from the Eighth Avenue buildings.

The replacement secondary school is already over capacity. New Westminster Secondary (820 Sixth Street, opened January 11, 2021, $106.5 million, 1,900 seats) is SD40's only secondary school and its long-range facilities plan notes it is already operating above capacity — for family buyers the elementary catchment (Lord Tweedsmuir, with Early French Immersion on site) is the real differentiator between Moody Park addresses.

Moody Park is a documented heritage neighbourhood. The City lists Moody Park among its Historic Neighbourhood Context Statements — heritage status is checked property by property, and work on a listed property can need heritage approvals, which matters for strata exterior-work planning in the older low-rises.

No floodplain zone covers the plateau. The City's floodplain study zones only the low-lying edges (Queensborough, the Quay, the Brunette River and west-end industrial lands) — Moody Park's plateau carries no confirmed floodplain zone, a genuine contrast with the Quay buildings down the hill, though lot-level status is still a City check.

blocks.text: Townhome complexes in Moody Park
Streets, schools and getting around Moody Park

items.t: Moody Park is the City of New Westminster neighbourhood centred on Moody Park itself, in the Uptown-west area between 6th Avenue and 8th Avenue; the City documents it in its Historic Neighbourhood Context Statements, and "Moody Park" is also the GVR board sub-area name in the SnapStats GVR September 2026 report — City name and board name match. Precise OCP boundary roads: UNVERIFIED.
Nearby areas: Uptown to the east, Brow of the Hill to the west, Glenbrooke North to the north, and Downtown and the Quay down the hill to the south.

Where the attached stock actually sits: there is no townhouse node. The strata stock is apartment buildings on the 6th Street / 8th Avenue edges; the streets around the park are single-detached houses under the RS districts.

Transit and roads: no SkyTrain station is inside Moody Park; the nearest are New Westminster Station and Columbia Station (Expo Line) downtown. TransLink routes 105 (Uptown / New Westminster Station) and 106 (Edmonds Station / New Westminster Station) serve the adjoining Uptown corridors; 8th Avenue, 6th Avenue, 8th Street and 10th Street serve the area.

Schools: SD40 catchments are address-based. For the sample address 1714 Eighth Avenue, the SD40 School Locator returns École Lord Tweedsmuir Elementary (K–6, with Early French Immersion at the school itself), Fraser River Middle (6–8) and New Westminster Secondary (9–12); other addresses may differ, and no home is promised a specific school.

blocks.text: Good to know about Moody Park

items.t: The "townhouse" zoning exists even though the townhouse stock does not: Bylaw 6680's Townhouse District RT-2 (s. 410) expressly permits row houses and townhouses, and the OCP carries a whole Development Permit Area (1.3) for townhouse form — a buyer waiting for new townhouse product here is waiting on rezoning and assembly, not on a missing rule.

The park is the amenity building: Moody Park itself holds the outdoor pool, spray park and sports fields, Moody Park Arena is at 701 8th Avenue, and the təməsew̓txʷ Aquatic and Community Centre at 65 East Sixth Avenue fully opened in May 2024 — at 10,644 sq. m. the City's largest capital project to date.

New Westminster runs its own electrical utility — City power, water and sewer, not BC Hydro for electricity — a carrying-cost detail that surprises buyers arriving from other suburbs; a 2026 utility dollar figure for a Moody Park house: UNVERIFIED.

Heritage is a live check, not a footnote: Moody Park is one of the neighbourhoods documented in the City's Historic Neighbourhood Context Statements, and heritage status must be checked property by property before planning renovations to an older home.

The replacement New Westminster Secondary School, 820 Sixth Street, opened to students on January 11, 2021 — a $106.5 million, 1,900-seat building — and SD40 operates only this one secondary school, which is why the elementary catchment (Lord Tweedsmuir, with Early French Immersion on site) is the real school differentiator on these streets.
The Main Branch of New Westminster Public Library is at 716 6th Avenue, at the area's east edge in Uptown — walking-distance civic infrastructure the townhouse nodes in newer suburbs do not have.

blocks.text: Lots and land in Moody Park
Fee-simple lots

items.t: Park-street house lots: single-detached houses under the Single Detached Residential Districts (RS series, s.310) of Zoning Bylaw No. 6680, 2001, on the residential streets around the park, with apartment buildings on the 6th Street / 8th Avenue edges under multiple-unit residential districts.

Lot character from the zones: RS-1 sets a minimum site area of 557.40 m² (6,000 sq. ft.) and a floor space ratio of 0.5; the edge apartment district RM-1 (s.420) sets maximum site coverage of 40% and density of 35 units per net acre / FSR 1.2. The RS figures are zone minimums, not a claim about any existing lot's size; the zone and dimensions of a specific lot are confirmed parcel by parcel (UNVERIFIED for any individual lot).

Serviced position, as the City states it: New Westminster operates its own electrical utility and City water / sewer services, and the City's subdivision guide states new lots must be adequately serviced with water, sewers, underground electrical, communications, street lighting, roads, sidewalks and street trees. Servicing for any single parcel is confirmed through that subdivision process — UNCONFIRMED parcel-by-parcel here.

ALR vs non-ALR: no Agricultural Land Reserve land is identified in Moody Park in the sources read; ALR status for a specific property is a per-address check in the Agricultural Land Commission's ALR Property and Map Finder. No ALR percentage split is stated.

Flood position: the City's floodplain study zones only the city's low-lying edges — Zone 1 Queensborough, Zone 2 west-end Fraser River industrial land, Zone 3 the Quay waterfront and Zone 4 the Brunette River industrial area. No floodplain zone for the Moody Park plateau was confirmed; lot-level status is UNVERIFIED and is a City check.

Market context, labelled correctly: New Westminster IS a SnapStats-covered community. SnapStats has NO land category, and no detached figure below is a land figure. September 2026 context only: Moody Park sub-area detached inventory 9 / solds 1 (11% ratio) and "Condos & Townhomes" combined 4 / 0; New Westminster community detached median $1,365,000 and combined condos & townhomes median $560,000. Sub-area medians are UNVERIFIED (community level only).

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Moody Park

items.t: SSMUH / added units as the research states them: the RS districts allow secondary suites and regulate laneway / carriage houses under Bylaw No. 6680, 2001, within the RS-1 frame above. A Moody Park-specific SSMUH unit-count figure on a City source is UNCONFIRMED in the research — pull City permits before advertising suite or laneway income on any lot.

ALR rules (for completeness — no Moody Park ALR parcel is confirmed here): subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s.6; SPA s.239; ALCA s.21(1)); ALC residence caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha). Farm-class thresholds are not documented in this area's own research, so no farm-class figure is asserted here.

faq.q: What recreation is in Moody Park?
faq.a: The park itself has an outdoor pool, spray park and sports fields, Moody Park Arena is at 701 8th Avenue, and the təməsew̓txʷ Aquatic and Community Centre at 65 East Sixth Avenue is a short distance east.

faq.q: What sold in Moody Park in September 2026?
faq.a: One detached home (9 listed, an 11% sales ratio) and no condos & townhomes (4 listed); at the New Westminster community level the detached median sale price was $1,365,000 and the condos & townhomes median was $560,000 (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Which schools serve a Moody Park address?
faq.a: For the sample address 1714 Eighth Avenue, the SD40 locator result is École Lord Tweedsmuir Elementary (which offers Early French Immersion), Fraser River Middle and New Westminster Secondary; catchments are address-based.

faq.q: Is there a SkyTrain station in Moody Park?
faq.a: No — the nearest stations are New Westminster Station and Columbia Station on the Expo Line, downtown at the foot of the hill; TransLink routes 105 and 106 connect the adjoining Uptown corridors to the stations.

faq.q: How many condos are there in Moody Park, really?
faq.a: Very few. This is a house neighbourhood with a thin condo edge.

faq.q: Can I have a pet at The Diplomat?
faq.a: The building directory records pets not allowed at The Diplomat (707 Eighth Street), and a listing feature sheet for the building says the same ("sorry no pets"). Pet bylaws remain enforceable in BC — unlike rental bylaws — so confirm on the Form B, but plan on no pets.

faq.q: What about pets at The Doncaster or Moody Gardens?
faq.a: The Doncaster's directory line is pets allowed with restrictions. At Moody Gardens, one current listing states "2 small pets allowed" — listing-level only; the registered bylaw position is UNCONFIRMED until the strata package is read.

faq.q: Can I rent out a Moody Park condo long-term?
faq.a: Yes — strata rental-restriction bylaws have been unenforceable since November 24, 2022 anywhere in BC. The Diplomat's directory line already records rentals allowed; The Doncaster's "rentals allowed w/restrictions" line is older wording. Short-term rentals are a separate question and can still be restricted.

faq.q: How old is this stock, and what does that mean for levies?
faq.a: The dated buildings are 1976 (Villa Franciscan), 1977 (The Diplomat, The Doncaster), 1983 (Fraser Gardens) and 1987 (Moody Gardens) — 40-to-50-year-old low-rises. Stratas with 5+ lots must now hold a depreciation report renewed every five years and contribute at least 10% of the operating fund to the CRF annually; read both documents before subject removal.

faq.q: Is there actually a townhouse complex in Moody Park?
Moody Gardens units are two levels — isn't that a townhouse?
faq.a: In form, partly; in classification, no.

faq.q: A listing on Eighth Avenue says "townhouse" — is it in Moody Park?
faq.a: Check the sub-area field, not the street name: the Row / Townhouse listing at 85 Eighth Avenue is Eight West in Glenbrooke North, north of the Moody Park extent.
